_comment: LaunchBox platform -> RetroArch libretro core .dll. On deploy, RomFleet auto-adds the EmulatorPlatform association (RetroArch + this core, default) if the endpoint doesn't already have one, so a platform 'just works' without hand-setting the core. Bootstrapped from a working LaunchBox install; RetroArch-core systems only (standalone emulators like Dolphin/PCSX2/BigPEmu are left to the operator). Arcadia 2001 + Interton VC 4000 have no libretro core (MAME/standalone) and are intentionally absent.
_Nintendo DSi: STANDALONE BizHawk/EmuHawk (Emulators\BizHawk\EmuHawk.exe, cmd --fullscreen, AutoExtract=false). DSi RetroAchievements are only earnable in BizHawk's melonDS core (DSi mode + real DSi BIOS/NAND via FirmwareUserSpecifications); the melonds_libretro core is DS-only for RA here. ensure_emulator no-ops (no core mapping); stamp_game_emulator points games at the BizHawk EmulatorPlatform (Default=true) on the endpoint. Regular 'Nintendo DS' stays on RetroArch melonDS above.
_Atari Jaguar CD: STANDALONE BizHawk/EmuHawk (Virtual Jaguar core; boot/CD/memtrack ROMs are embedded in the core, no external BIOS needed). Not RetroArch here — virtualjaguar_libretro can't earn Jaguar CD RA. cmd --fullscreen, AutoExtract=false (raw multi-track .cue/.bin + .cdi must NOT be extracted). ensure_emulator no-ops; stamp points games at the BizHawk EmulatorPlatform. Note: cartridge 'Atari Jaguar' remains on RetroArch virtualjaguar above.
_NEC PC-8801: STANDALONE RAQUASI88 (not a libretro core) — the quasi88_libretro core loads all BIOS but will NOT autoboot NeoKobe .d88 disks (hangs at N88-DISK-BASIC How-many-files prompt). RAQUASI88 standalone autoboots them. Set up as a manual EmulatorPlatform association (Emulators\RAQUASI88\RAQUASI88.exe, cmd -v2 -fullscreen -english -f10 FULLSCREEN, AutoExtract=true, Default=true); ensure_emulator no-ops here, stamp_game_emulator points games at it.
_Sony PSP: STANDALONE PPSSPP (Emulators\PPSSPP\PPSSPPWindows64.exe, cmd --escape-exit --fullscreen, AutoExtract=false). RetroArch ppsspp_libretro cannot hash .cso for RetroAchievements (libretro #16953); PPSSPP reads CSO natively + has RA. Flip back to the core (+ dormant bezel in config\PPSSPP) once #16953 lands. ensure_emulator no-ops here; stamp_game_emulator points games at the standalone assoc.
